segments.he: מַתְנִי' הָיְתָה לְמוּדָה לִהְיוֹת רוֹאָה יוֹם חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר, וְשִׁינְּתָה לִהְיוֹת רוֹאָה לְיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים — זֶה וָזֶה אֲסוּרִין. שִׁינְּתָה פַּעֲמַיִם לְיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים — זֶה וָזֶה אֲסוּרִין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If the woman «was accustomed to see» the flow of blood on the «fifteenth day and she deviated» from the norm «to see» the flow of blood «on» the «twentieth day,» then on both «this» day, the fifteenth, «and that» day, the twentieth, it is «prohibited» for her to engage in intercourse. If «she deviated» from the norm «twice,» then on both «this» day, the fifteenth, «and that» day, the twentieth, it is likewise «prohibited» for her to engage in intercourse.

segments.he: שִׁינְּתָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים לְיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים — הוּתַּר חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר, וְקָבְעָה לָהּ יוֹם עֶשְׂרִים, שֶׁאֵין אִשָּׁה קוֹבַעַת לָהּ וֶסֶת עַד שֶׁתִּקְבָּעֶנָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים, וְאֵינָהּ מִטַּהֶרֶת מִן הַוֶּסֶת עַד שֶׁתֵּעָקֵר מִמֶּנָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים.
segments.en: If «she deviated» from the norm «to see» the flow of blood «on» the «twentieth day three times, it becomes permitted» for her to engage in intercourse on the «fifteenth, and she» has «established the twentieth day for herself» as the day of her fixed menstrual cycle, «as a woman establishes» a fixed menstrual «cycle only after she establishes it three times. And» a woman «is purified from the» existing fixed menstrual «cycle,» in the sense that intercourse is permitted on that day, «only when she has been displaced from» that day «three times.»

moves.cueHe: היתה למודה להיות רואה יום חמשה עשר
moves.summary: one or two deviations to the twentieth: both days prohibited
three deviations fix the twentieth; a cycle is fixed and uprooted only by three

positions.claim: one or two deviations prohibit both days; three establish the new day and free the old
